notes: balanceVersion 3 adds the 20-stamina save migration; the version does not distinguish every historical economic experiment.

V4 repricing has 50 historical one-hour trajectories. Current V5 has two paired groups of eight policies and ten seeds, 160 one-hour trajectories total. The old-price endgame proof is not a current population completion-time estimate.
The completion audit continues the same endgame trajectory and is not an independent sample.
Instant management requires active play; it is not unattended automatic revenue.
Raw settled payouts and unclaimed active-player valuations are separate.
V3 full equipment rewrite supersedes V2 44-item and V4/V5 old-equipment economic outputs; new staged fixtures do not measure acquisition time.
V3 primary and offline saturation tests total 1,826,536 real shots excluding smoke/rechecks and from-zero journeys.
From-zero milestone time statistics exclude non-attainers; 19 of 32 no-equipment runs were right-censored at 24 hours, not counted as successful completions.

Original name/art reuse changes presentation only; the V3 balance fingerprint and 306-coupon prices are unchanged. Selected recruitment is a separate unimplemented proposal; its shadow results are not included in current-game balance counts.
